canonicalization.strings: no Unicode normalization; standard JSON escaping, no unnecessary ASCII escapes
canonicalization.numbers: protocol/template metadata safe integers only; typed records allow finite IEEE754 numbers; use ECMAScript JSON.stringify number encoding for record digests
canonicalization.hash: SHA-256 lowercase hex; TemplateRevision excludes top-level contentHash, RulePlan excludes planHash; other digest envelopes explicitly omit digest

db.note: no extra broker/connection/store. runs singleton slot row stores slot owner + retired target evidence; commandJournal stores host/target registrations and tombstones as tagged records, downloadReceipts stores tagged attempt/candidate/receipt records. Reject unknown record tag. Design permits indexed subkeys in existing stores. target-create tagged intents are durable in commandJournal; browser-session incarnation in trusted chrome.storage.session is a transient identity fence, not a second data DB.
db.migrations: failed upgrade transaction rolls back; keep prior DB intact/read-only, raw backup copy; never deleteDatabase on failure

moduleSlot.export: createScrapingModule({contracts, storage, pagePort, runCommands, exportBridge, entitlement, clock})
moduleSlot.controller: RunHost independently owns createRunner/run loop; UI observes state only
moduleSlot.fixedRootImport: src/run-host.js imports package scraping slot exactly once; phase03 fills slot with domain code without root edits
noDirectAccess: chrome.* outside PagePort/selection adapter approved by foundation
moduleSlot.phase02Slot: fixed single placeholder with explicit MODULE_NOT_INSTALLED, not a fake completed runner

interfaces.name: registerHost
interfaces.semantics: SW compares actual extension page sender.id/url/documentId; no self-asserted webpage owner; registration alone does not claim run

interfaces.name: saveTemplate
interfaces.semantics: IDB templates CAS immutable revision; duplicate exact payload returns same revision; parent mismatch conflicts; template mutable display name is metadata outside contentHash, bounded nonempty 128 chars, CAS nameRevision; saveTemplate supplies name and naming is never inferred from selectors

interfaces.name: compileTemplate
interfaces.semantics: structural validation + real DOM CSS compile + semantic validation; same implementation for preview and run

interfaces.name: claimRun
interfaces.semantics: CAS global slot in runs; no previous slot released until fenced+retired; acquire explicit optional origin permission from user gesture before dedicated tab; on failure retire

interfaces.name: bindTarget
interfaces.semantics: SW records actual tab frame0 documentId from fixed agent handshake; exact origin; source tab never becomes execution tab; targetVersion increments on authenticated navigation/new document binding; fixed documentId side effects, not tabs.update; caller cannot nominate arbitrary createdTabId; only known registered TargetCreationIntent exact tab/document may bind

interfaces.name: prepareCommand
interfaces.semantics: same commandId+digest idempotent; different digest conflict; allow only package-defined commands

interfaces.name: dispatchCommand
interfaces.semantics: short ACK after dispatched IDB commit, before Chrome call; no entire-run promise; check cancel/revision/epoch/target/grant each dispatch

interfaces.name: confirmCommand
interfaces.semantics: validate actual sender and target document; late/duplicate ACK never reruns action

interfaces.name: stopRun
interfaces.semantics: IDB cancel commit orders against dispatch and seal; duplicate requestId idempotent; stop increments runRevision but not ownerEpoch; terminal winner preserved

interfaces.name: stagePageBatch
interfaces.semantics: IDB runs+batches+records+pageSnapshots transaction; no committed count/checkpoint movement; max2 unACKed; requires beginPage-open snapshot bound to readCommandId+sourceIdentity; never allocates arbitrary snapshot implicitly

interfaces.name: sealPage
interfaces.semantics: single IDB transaction runs+pageSnapshots+batches; contiguous indexes, exact row/bytes/digests; visibility follows sealed flag; sealSeq assigned monotonically and returned; save sealIdentity and immutableSealAck in same transaction; exact historic repeat returns saved ACK without touching current projection/counters, except duplicate=true

interfaces.name: readRecords
interfaces.semantics: only snapshots sealed at <=watermark; preserve raw values; export/cleanup reader pin prevents delete races

interfaces.name: abandonUnknown
interfaces.semantics: atomic ownerEpoch++, revoke old target capability and commands, abort open snapshots; no slot release yet

interfaces.name: retireTarget
interfaces.semantics: Chrome remove exact old tab; verify tabs.get not found/tab-removed event; exact old target registration revoked. Closing window alone or lease timeout is insufficient; current browserSessionIncarnation and durable creation ownership required before any numeric-tab removal; across-session unverified target freezes with no remove; release CAS matches currentRunId/fencedEpoch/retirementId and commits released evidence atomically, duplicates return historical result and never clear a newer slot

interfaces.name: snapshotRun
interfaces.semantics: durable projection, bounded events with seq; UI resync on event gaps; no UI-owned loop; exact nested Projection, run:null is legitimate idle; pendingCommandIds is empty when idle; slotAvailable is actual singleton slot truth, not assumed true

interfaces.name: prepareExport
interfaces.semantics: pin seal watermark and counts; scraping formatter reads cursors and returns deterministic volume bytes; foundation owns persistence+Blob lifetime

interfaces.name: dispatchDownload
interfaces.semantics: prepare attempt durable before Chrome; dispatch commit then at most1 downloads.download call; gap is unknown, not retry

interfaces.name: reconcileDownload
interfaces.semantics: bind only unique full URL+extension+time match; known ID authoritative; 0 finite mapping search, multiple conflict

interfaces.name: retryExport
interfaces.semantics: new job+fresh attempt+never-reused Blob per volume; old artifact/activeAttemptIds/submission authority frozen, but old job delivery aggregate can still resolve from its own late receipt. Explicit abandon/tombstone alone freezes projection. Old receipt cannot complete new job.

interfaces.name: deleteRun
interfaces.semantics: fence active owner; retire target and pin downloads/readers; mark unresolved attempts abandoned; tombstone prevents late reply resurrecting records

interfaces.name: listTemplates
interfaces.semantics: bounded repository metadata+immutable head; no direct IDB in domain UI

interfaces.name: getTemplateRevision
interfaces.semantics: exact immutable revision, verify hash; missing fails E_SCHEMA not guessed latest

interfaces.name: renameTemplate
interfaces.semantics: CAS expectedNameRevision; display-name-only change preserves revision contentHash

interfaces.name: exportTemplateBackup
interfaces.output: versioned TemplateRevision + metadata envelope through normal Artifact/download bridge
interfaces.semantics: local explicit backup, preserve complete schema/hash; no remote execution or cloud upload

interfaces.name: importTemplateBackup
interfaces.output: validated draft or TemplateEntry after preview confirmation
interfaces.semantics: raw backup durable before parse; duplicate JSON keys rejected; exact id/revision conflicting digest never overwritten; explicit create-new-id can save new template through quota/CAS

interfaces.name: beginPage
interfaces.semantics: IDB runs+pageSnapshots+journal transaction reserves readCommandId and allocates/exactly re-ACKs one open snapshot before prepareCommand; next sequence/checkpoint CAS/full source identity. prepareCommand subsequently binds reserved read ID to this snapshot/plan; stage/seal require authenticated dispatched read+end evidence. Allows zero-stage empty pages.

interfaces.name: createTarget
interfaces.semantics: durable unique target-create intent before tabs.create; commit dispatched under cancel/revision/grant/session checks; at most1 call to exact package bootstrap URL. Bootstrap authenticated sender binds unique creationId before startUrl navigation. gap never replayed.

interfaces.name: reconcileTargetCreation
interfaces.semantics: read-only exact extension bootstrap URL/nonce + actual extension sender tab/document; 0/many evidence stays unknown, slot held. Late callback belongs original run/retirement; never binds successor.

interfaces.name: openSourceContext
interfaces.semantics: SW issues gestureTicket from actual action.onClicked source tab before opening/focusing tool; single-use ticket expires30s. registered actual host consumes ticket; fixed classic source handshake binds tab/frame/document/origin, no caller-asserted activeTab grant. context expires10min or source navigation/host loss/session fence.

interfaces.name: startSourceSelection
interfaces.semantics: one current operationId per source context; fixed package SelectorUI asset under02B approved injection,03 code. actual sender authenticated. async result never uses executeScript evaluation return; new operation cancels previous and cleans only owned resources.

interfaces.name: cancelSourceSelection
interfaces.semantics: idempotent cancellation tombstone precedes cleanup; queued late same operation result audit-only and cannot overwrite new selection/draft. fixed cancel/dispose owns explicit overlay/listener/timer handles.

interfaces.name: releaseSourceContext
interfaces.semantics: CAS contextRevision idempotently invalidates all selection/preview operations; removes only owned resources. navigation/host close/expiry/reload same invalidation; no formal run target disposal.

interfaces.name: previewSource
interfaces.semantics: unpersisted structurally/semantically valid draft TemplateRevision allowed; verify draft hash and RulePlan binding against supplied draft, not stored template. raw-only source reader<=10 full rows, shared compiler transforms atHost;128KiB frames,64KiB record budget, field keys exact,1frame ACK backpressure. no navigation/run slot/stage/seal/export/Pro requirement.

error.retryable: boolean; never true for uncertain external effect

semantics.stageAckMeaning: durable staged; invisible until whole page sealed
semantics.limits: +1 causes limit_reached, never success; cannot truncate current page into a falsely complete page
semantics.sourcePage: selection only; formal run requires dedicated new target tab

entitlementPolicy.signatureEncoding: base64url no padding of 64-byte IEEE-P1363 R||S, WebCrypto ECDSA P256/SHA256; package-fixed keyId allowlist
entitlementPolicy.claimsSchema: Entitlement, canonical signing payload excludes signature/verification/verifiedAt/lastTrustedTime; issuer/subject/audience/features/issuedAt/expiresAt/keyId/revocationVersion bound

recordDigests.stage: sha256 canonical({snapshotId,batchIndex,records}) excluding digest; utf8Bytes exact same envelope bytes
recordDigests.page: SHA256(od-json-1({pageIdentity: normalized authenticated document URL, records:[{raw,values}] in rowIndex order})); excludes snapshotId/recordKey/run/host/epoch/document identities; exact oracle contracts/fixtures/page-signature.json

sourceSelection.authority: actual user-gesture and activeTab grant; SW binds actual source tab/document and allowedOperations
sourceSelection.entry: source selection adapter uses fixed package classic selector with async message result; no executeScript evaluation-result business dependency
sourceSelection.protocol: existing PagePort methods;02B owns authority/transport/lifecycle,03 owns fixed SelectorUI + draft compiler/UI; no separate owner/bridge/DB
sourceSelection.draftPreview: same compiler as formal run; uses source context and supplied immutable draft hash/plan binding, not a saved-template requirement
sourceSelection.lateResult: cancel/release/context invalidation wins; operationId never reused; only current context/document/operation selected result can updateUI
sourceSelection.storage: short-lived source-context/gesture-ticket/cancel tagged records in existing commandJournal; expires/tombstones for late rejection; no records/runs created
sourceSelection.eventDelivery: 02B pagePort subscription maps actual registered host document/selectionId;03 subscribes before start and unsubscribes on context dispose. Invalidated/cancel events follow same route. Listener is local packaged code only.

migrationIssueCodes: contracts/fixtures/migration/*/vector.json expected.errors[].code are domain issue details under E_MIGRATION_RECONFIGURE; do not replace transport error codes

methods.nextLink: ({identity,commandId,selector,url,endMarkerSelector,priorPageSignature,waitMs}) -> short journal ACK; read-only reconciliation follows
methods.nextButton: ({identity,commandId,selector,endMarkerSelector,priorPageSignature,userConfirmed,postcondition,timeoutMs}) -> short journal ACK; read-only reconciliation follows
methods.previewSource: (PreviewSourceRequest) -> AsyncIterator<SourcePreviewFrame>; module preview applies shared compiler -> SourcePreviewResult
methods.subscribeSourceSelection: ({selectionId}, listener) -> unsubscribe(); local packaged callback receives authenticated SourceSelectionResult/SourceOperationAck lifecycle events, never serialized code

pagePort.rawOnlyAgent: fixed package DOM agent reads raw text/attribute only; shared domain compiler transforms in RunHost for both preview/run, no JS expression accepted
pagePort.planBinding: admission checks templateHash/compilerVersion/planHash and plan fields match stored immutable template; caller cannot supply arbitrary broader plan
pagePort.frames: runtime JSON only, <=128KiB raw data frames with command/snapshot/frame identity, monotonic frameIndex/rowStart; identical digest duplicate ignored, conflicting frame fails whole page; end frame proves expected frame/row counts
pagePort.backpressure: at most2 host stage ACKs pending, explicit page-frame ACK after corresponding durable stage; host may split raw frame into <=256KiB canonical stages without splitting a record; no more data after stop
pagePort.preview: same raw reader and compiler transform, source-target selection context capability; display<=10 rows only; output raw retained untruncated
pagePort.sender: frame payload identity not authority; actual sender extensionId/tabId/frameId/documentId checked against registered exact target

templates.countPolicy: nondeleted distinct templateIds, revision update does not consume another saved-template slot
templates.naming: mutable TemplateMetadata.name outside revision contentHash, CAS nameRevision
templates.delete: explicit template delete preserves runs referenced immutable revision/hash; migration raw backups retained until explicit deletion
templates.backup: local versioned JSON import/export; raw backup persisted before any conversion, no CSS/code execution

componentScope: all regular files under contracts/fixtures except executable verifier .py/.cjs and mutable validation-report.json
contractHashDefinition.note: component sha256 hashes exact saved bytes; bundle-manifest.json holds computed components and resulting contractHash; no self-referential hash stored inside contract.json. Design deliverables not in contractHash still hashed by separate delivery manifest.

targetLifecycle.sessionFence: SW serialized coordinator generates random browserSessionIncarnation once in chrome.storage.session (trusted extension contexts only); persists SW restarts, clears with browser-session restart; never trust content supplied incarnation; storage.session also clears on extension disable/reload/update, so these conservatively create a new incarnation and revoke all old numeric-tab authority. Initialization awaits a single coordinator promise before admission; no independently generated incarnation per request.
targetLifecycle.create: unique durable creationId and exact chrome-extension bootstrap URL; bootstrap handshake persisted before navigation; tabs.create at most once after journal dispatched
targetLifecycle.unknown: 0/multiple candidates or callback gap freezes slot, no blind new tab
targetLifecycle.neverCreated: only cancelled/prepared intent with submissionCount=0 and no dispatched commit; target:null is insufficient
targetLifecycle.crossSession: numeric old tabId never authorizes remove/get absence in a new session; unique restored package bootstrap nonce may rebind current exact sender; navigated unidentifiable restored targets stay frozen with explicit unsupported automatic recovery. Confirmed results remain exportable; no automatic profile reset or deletion.
targetLifecycle.release: single IDB runs+journal transaction checks slot currentRunId/fencedEpoch/retirementId and old releaseCount=0; stores immutable release result and clears matching slot once only
targetLifecycle.initialNavigation: known bootstrap registration is creation ownership, not formal HTTP(S) target. Same target-create tagged intent holds navigationState/dispatchAt/submissionCount. Initial location.assign in exact bootstrap document is journal-admitted once under cancel/epoch/current session/grant, no tabs.update; dispatch→navigation gap is effect_unknown, no replay. Fixed package agent at start URL authenticates new actual document before business bindTarget/read admission.
